errors.text_span: wobei die Linie im Jahr 2011 bei etwa 7,0 beginnt
errors.evidence: The line for men (Männer) starts at approximately 6.9 in 2011, which is visibly below the 7.0 line.
The value for men in 2018 is 7.0, and it never reaches 7.2 in the period from 2011 to 2018. The phrase 'bleibt bei' (remains at) is also an over-generalization of the fluctuating trend.

errors.text_span: Anschließend sinkt sie auf 6,8 im Jahr 2019
errors.evidence: In 2019, the value for men is at its peak, approximately 7.15. The line begins to sink *after* 2019. The value 6.8 is incorrect for 2019.

errors.text_span: erreicht ihren niedrigsten Punkt bei 6,6 im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The lowest point for men in 2021 is approximately 6.65, not 6.6.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis 2024 leicht auf 7,0 ansteigt
errors.evidence: The final value for men in 2024 is approximately 7.1, not 7.0.

errors.text_span: die im Jahr 2011 bei etwa 6,9 beginnt
errors.evidence: The line for women (Frauen) starts at approximately 7.0 in 2011, not 6.9.
The line for women fluctuates between 2011 and 2017. Stating that it 'bleibt' (remains) at a certain value is an over-generalization of this trend.

errors.text_span: Dann sinkt sie auf 6,7 im Jahr 2019, 6,5 im Jahr 2020 und erreicht ihren niedrigsten Punkt bei 6,3 im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: This sequence of values and years is incorrect. In 2019, the value for women peaks at ~7.15. The value in 2020 is ~6.7. The lowest point is in 2021, but at a value of ~6.55, not 6.3. The description misattributes several values to the wrong years.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis 2024 wieder auf 7,0 ansteigt
errors.evidence: The final value for women in 2024 is approximately 7.1, not 7.0.
The description does not mention the marker shape (circles) used for the data points on both lines.
